question: Identify female patients born between 1970 and 1979 who have had at least two laboratory tests showing abnormal glutamic pyruvic transaminase (GPT) levels, and return their ID, current age, and admission status.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  T1."XCL_058" AS ID,
  CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', T1."XCL_060") AS INTEGER) AS current_age,
  T3."XCL_013" AS admission_status
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2
  ON T1."XCL_058" = T2."XCL_014"
INNER JOIN Examination AS T3
  ON T1."XCL_058" = T3."XCL_001"
WHERE T1."XCL_059" = 'F'
  AND CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', T1."XCL_060") AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1970 AND 1979
  AND T2."XCL_016" = 1
  AND T2."XCL_017" > 40
GROUP BY T1."XCL_058", T3."XCL_013"
HAVING COUNT(T2."XCL_014") >= 2

SELECT DISTINCT
  T1."XCL_058" AS ID,
  CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', T1."XCL_060") AS INTEGER) AS current_age,
  T3."XCL_013" AS admission_status
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2
  ON T1."XCL_058" = T2."XCL_014"
INNER JOIN Examination AS T3
  ON T1."XCL_058" = T3."XCL_001"
WHERE T1."XCL_059" = 'F'
  AND CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', T1."XCL_060") AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1970 AND 1979
  AND T2."XCL_016" = 1
  AND T2."XCL_017" > 40
GROUP BY T1."XCL_058", T3."XCL_013"
HAVING COUNT(T2."XCL_014") >= 2

entity_grain_realization.pre_realization_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  T1."XCL_058" AS ID,
  CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', T1."XCL_060") AS INTEGER) AS current_age,
  T3."XCL_013" AS admission_status
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2
  ON T1."XCL_058" = T2."XCL_014"
INNER JOIN Examination AS T3
  ON T1."XCL_058" = T3."XCL_001"
WHERE T1."XCL_059" = 'F'
  AND CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', T1."XCL_060") AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1970 AND 1979
  AND T2."XCL_016" = 1
  AND T2."XCL_017" > 40
GROUP BY T1."XCL_058", T3."XCL_013"
HAVING COUNT(T2."XCL_014") >= 2

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_058" AS ID,
       CAST(strftime('%Y','now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1."XCL_060") AS INTEGER) AS current_age,
       T1."XCL_063" AS admission_status
FROM Patient AS T1
WHERE T1."XCL_059" = 'F'
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', T1."XCL_060") AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1970 AND 1979
  AND (SELECT COUNT(*)
       FROM Laboratory AS T2
       WHERE T2."XCL_014" = T1."XCL_058"
         AND T2."XCL_016" = 1
         AND T2."XCL_017" > 40) >= 2

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT 
    p.XCL_058 AS ID,
    (julianday('now') - julianday(p.XCL_060)) / 365.25 AS current_age,
    p.XCL_064 AS admission_status
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.XCL_058 = l.XCL_014
WHERE p.XCL_063 = 'F'
  AND p.XCL_060 BETWEEN '1970-01-01' AND '1979-12-31'
  AND l.XCL_021 > 40
GROUP BY p.XCL_058
HAVING COUNT(l.XCL_014) >= 2
